notes: Same site/access method as bs58/cl58 (Googlebot-UA pre-rendered HTML + same-origin /api/items REST call, tier 1 only, no block encountered). /new/shop-new-arrivals is a category-SELECTOR hub, not a PLP: its own H1 is 'Shop by Category' and its items API total is 0 (no products assigned to that URL directly) - excluded as a row per Sec.3 ('marketing/editorial landing page' test), consistent with brief guidance that a 'New Collection'-style page needs inspection every time. The genuine 'view all' PLP for the whole New Arrivals concept is /new/shop-new-arrivals/new-view-all (H1 'All New Arrivals', title 'All New Arrivals | pottery barn kids UK', items API total=211) - used as the parent/canonical row instead. Below it sit 8 genuine site-defined category-scoped New Arrivals PLPs found via the same hub's own category tiles (Baby, Backpacks & Lunch, Bath, Bed Linen, Decor, Furniture, Rugs, Toys & Playroom) - each confirmed by its own distinct H1 and items-API total, not aliases of each other or of the view-all page. Children do not sum to the parent (14+19+3+40+40+15+12+15=158 vs parent 211) which is expected/normal overlap behaviour, not an error. Also checked and excluded /new/featured-new/collaborations/* (character/brand tie-in shops, not a 'newly added' concept) and /new/featured-new/sustainability-shop/* (material/certification filters). No ambiguous 'Collection'-named pages required a MANUAL REVIEW flag - all candidates were unambiguously either real dated New Arrivals listings or non-listing hub pages.
